evidence.uv_resolution_failure_on_darwin: No solution found when resolving dependencies: because all versions of isaaclab have no wheels with a matching Python ABI tag (e.g., cp312) and you require isaaclab, we can conclude that your requirements are unsatisfiable.
evidence.platform: Apple M4 Pro (darwin arm64), 24 GB RAM, no NVIDIA GPU
evidence.docker_path: Docker on macOS cannot pass an NVIDIA GPU to a Linux VM (CUDA passthrough unsupported on darwin); the M4 Pro has no NVIDIA GPU regardless.

rationale: Isaac Sim/Lab publishes no macOS wheels and requires an NVIDIA GPU. No feasible install path exists on this platform without new hardware or an external Linux GPU host.
what_would_unblock: x86_64 Linux machine or VM with NVIDIA RTX GPU, or CI-based remote runner for Isaac Lab cells.
value_of_component: Independent PhysX physics backend, Factory/FORGE contact-rich assembly envs, AutoMate geometry-generalization assets — remains the top desired second backend on suitable hardware.
alternative_in_campaign: robosuite 1.5.2 (official OSC_POSE incumbent controllers, contact-rich NutAssembly/PegInHole envs) serves the independent-backend + incumbent-controller comparison on macOS CPU; MuJoCo solver-variation + optional Drake hydroelastic microbench covers the contact-formulation axis.
